title: Billy Bat Manga Wins Harvey Award
content: The Harvey Awards, which honor outstanding work in comics and sequential art, announced the winners for this year's awards on Friday at New York Comic Con . Naoki Urasawa and Takashi Nagasaki 's Billy Bat manga, released by Abrams ComicArts ' Kana imprint, won the award for Best Manga.
